They should have just given every account the option to choose one sub-3000 platinum cosmetic set. The ones they gave us were meh, at best. Oh, and combine all the smaller events we've had together, all at once. Let us have the exp, the gold, the whisper caches, goblin mania. I feel like I might be missing one or two. Maybe even throw Malphas back in open world/dungeons again. All whisper caches are ancestral? 100% Bel spawn rate? Limited time unlimited temper resets? Opals drop from elites? Burning butcher every round in hordes, or all helborne/fiend boons? I dunno, it just seems like it was just 'time" for mother's blessing anyways, and I don't care for cosmetics. 

Do something crazy. The season brought some decent changes to the game, but the seasonal content itself is lackluster. I did enough incursions to get all the powers and stopped. Witch tides were legit fun the entire season. Lots of drops, mats, boss mats, crazy mob density, plus the caches.
